mapper.select: select r.reservation_id, r.reserve_date,r.reserve_time,mc.card_id,mc.patient_name, mc.gender,mc.contact_phone,mc.age,dept.dept_name,d.doctor_name from reservation r inner join doctor d on d.doctor_no = r.doctor_no inner join medical_cards mc on mc.card_id = r.card_id inner join dept on d.dept_id = dept.dept_id where d.doctor_no=#{doctorNo};
mapper.insert: insert into medical_histories (medical_history, patient_description, doctor_advice, doctor_name, card_id, reservation_id) values (#{medical_history}, #{patientDescription}, #{doctorAdvice}, #{doctorName}, #{cardId}, #{reservationId})
mapper.update: update reservation set is_receive = 1 where reservation_id = #{reservationId}
